Name: DONKINS
Author: kattstro
Description:
Introducing DONKINS, a chunky duck replacer

Many years ago, I found and fell in love with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3640]CHONKINS[/url], and since that mod doesn't affect ducks, made a little companion mod I lovingly dubbed DONKINS. I'm not publsihing that mod. This just makes your ducks real chonky. There's not much else to it.


[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/22a0026d4b17c6d0f93765d23aa453de/07fec547067f48c9-8b/s250x400/07d8cf549f34ed7aa00bb3653c77641b9ba831d5.gif[/img]


[b][color=#ff7700][size=5]INSTALLATION[/size][/color][/b]
1. Install Content Patcher
2. Install Donkins
﻿Manual: Extract the .rar file to your /mods folder
﻿Vortex: Click the "download with mod manager" option and let Vortex do its thing

[color=#ff7700][size=5][b]COMPATABILITY[/b][/size][/color]
Not compatible with other duck replacers, for obvious reasons. Either uninstall/remove/disable them, or, if it's something like Elle's Cuter Coop Animals which has a generic mod menu, disable every duck option and set "duck default" to "false". This will prevent that mod from changing the duck sprite, meaning whatever replacer you use - like Donkins - will work. There will be info on that mod's page on how to do this! :)

Downloads.Description: Main file. Don't forget Content Patcher.
